name: dress_visual_seed_v1
description: Eight labeled dresses used to ground and evaluate the visual extractor. Each carries stated expected attributes, so extractor output can be scored against a fixed reference rather than against itself. Two entries are deliberate near-misses: a system that ranks them highly is matching the occasion but not the wearer's stated construction preferences.
_assumption: PLACEHOLDER PERMALINKS. The eight real permalinks were never supplied in conversation, so these shortcodes are invented and resolve to nothing. Replace `permalink` and `shortcode` with the real ones and set is_synthetic=false. Until that flag is false, no metric computed against this set may be reported as measured.

items.label: Bright warm-season mini, plunging neckline, exactly the My Tie target
items.notes: Positive anchor for bright / playful / late-summer.

items.label: Bright citrus mini with a one-shoulder asymmetric neckline
items.notes: Tests that asymmetric necklines score above straight-across.

items.label: Near-miss: right brightness and length, flat straight-across strapless
items.notes: CONTRAST CASE. Matches the occasion, conflicts with stated construction preferences. Should rank below the positives despite identical colour and hem.

items.label: Deep red long-sleeve mini with sequin surface, Christmas Cocktail target
items.notes: Positive anchor for holiday / sparkle / long sleeve.

items.label: Emerald velvet cowl-neck midi, cold-weather holiday styling
items.notes: Tests midi remaining eligible when the vibe match is strong.

items.label: Near-miss: correct holiday palette, heavy structured corset bodice
items.notes: CONTRAST CASE. Right palette, construction that depends on structured bust support.

items.label: Floor-length flowing gown, deep V, formal anchor
items.notes: Tests that maxi outranks mini once the event asks for it.

items.label: Deliberately hard image: cropped hem, dim lighting, partial garment
items.notes: EDGE CASE. Expected attributes are intentionally sparse. A correct extractor returns nulls and low confidence here rather than guessing; an extractor that fills every field confidently on this image is fabricating.
